title: With-flattening test did not exercise ResolvedViaWithFlattening
details: Build_WithFlattening_IndexesUnderInnerDeclaration used a parser-driven `With target / Debug.Print target` source whose references resolve as Resolved (not ResolvedViaWithFlattening), so the unwrap branch was not actually verified.
fix: Replaced the test with a hand-built ResolvedReference whose Outcome is ResolutionOutcome.ResolvedViaWithFlattening wrapping a real Resolved(targetDecl). Asserts the index finds the reference under targetDecl and confirms the outcome variant.
